segments.text: 3 months ago, one of the UK's most eminent and trusted cardiologists, a man with an international reputation, Dr Aseem Malhotra, published peer-reviewed research that concluded that there should be a complete cessation in the administration of the covid mRNA vaccines for everyone because of clear and robust data of significant harms and little ongoing benefit.
